# LocalCloud

LocalCloud provides 27 service guides and 25 documented local integrations in one local Docker runtime. Availability does not imply full Google Cloud parity or default startup. Firestore is disabled by default; Google Sheets provides a limited read-only values facade.

LocalCloud is not a production replacement. Use is governed by the proprietary LocalCloud license; review the license before use. The proprietary Public Preview License permits individuals and organizations, including for-profit companies, to use LocalCloud free of charge for internal development, testing, CI, evaluation, and internal pilots. Excluded uses include customer-facing or other production use, reselling LocalCloud or providing it as a hosted or managed service, redistribution or sublicensing, modification except where applicable law requires permission.

## Quick start

```bash
curl -fsSL https://local.cloud/install.sh | sh
localcloud doctor
localcloud start --local-only
eval "$(localcloud env)"
localcloud console
```

## Runtime facts

- Default project: `local-gcp-project`
- Default user: `local-developer`
- Default data volume: `localcloud-data`
- CLI memory default: `4g`
- Health endpoint: `http://localhost:5380/health`
- Shell environment endpoint: `http://localhost:5380/env?format=shell`
- Terraform environment endpoint: `http://localhost:5380/env?format=terraform`

Wait for `/readiness` before application traffic. Trust URLs and endpoint values returned by the selected CLI runtime; occupied canonical ports may be remapped. Select durable storage with `--data-volume NAME`; project and caller remain request context. LocalCloud emulates bounded local development workflows. Validate application behavior against real Google Cloud before production deployment.

## Services
- Cloud Storage — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5382; `STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5382`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Pub/Sub — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5383; `PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5383`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Firestore — supported; available but disabled by default; gRPC :5384; `FIRESTORE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5384`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Bigtable — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5385; `BIGTABLE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5385`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Spanner — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5386 · HTTP/REST :5387; `SPANNER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5386`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- BigQuery — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5388 · gRPC :5389; `BIGQUERY_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5388`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Google Sheets — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380; `SHEETS_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Secret Manager — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `SECRET_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud Tasks — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_TASKS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud Scheduler — supported; starts by default; grpc+rest :5380; `CLOUD_SCHEDULER_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud Functions (2nd Gen) — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_FUNCTIONS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- AlloyDB — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `ALLOYDB_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Dataproc — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `DATAPROC_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud IAM — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `IAM_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud Resource Manager — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380; `CLOUD_RESOURCE_MANAGER_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Service Usage — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380; `SERVICE_USAGE_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud Billing — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380; `CLOUD_BILLING_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud Logging — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_LOGGING_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud Monitoring — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_MONITORING_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- GKE — supported; available but disabled by default; gRPC :5380 · k3d :5443; `GKE_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Compute Engine — unsupported. No supported application integration is established; review the service guide before configuring a client.
- Cloud Run — supported; available but disabled by default; gRPC :5380; `CLOUD_RUN_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Memorystore (Redis/Valkey) — supported; starts by default; RESP :5390; `REDIS_HOST=localhost:5390`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud Workflows — supported; starts by default; gRPC :5380; `WORKFLOWS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Vertex AI — unsupported. No supported application integration is established; review the service guide before configuring a client.
- Cloud KMS — supported; starts by default; grpc+rest :5380; `CLOUD_KMS_EMULATOR_HOST=localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
- Cloud SQL — supported; starts by default; HTTP/REST :5380 · PostgreSQL :5391 · MySQL :5406; `CLOUD_SQL_EMULATOR_HOST=http://localhost:5380`. Supported for local workflows; real Google Cloud remains the production source of truth.
